Which behavior should the report view apply to active filters when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: A - B is what the workspace-change handler already does, so it adds no new behavior, and C would need new per-workspace filter state beside the resolver at settings/resolver.ts:12; A is the only change that needs no new state.
